en.title: What changes in paired tumor immune-expression measurements during nivolumab?
en.summary: Fixed immune scores in 43 public RNA pairs, with paired change, normalization sensitivity and patient-separated response-association diagnostics.
key_findings: In 43 public pre/on-nivolumab RNA pairs, a fixed cytolytic score rose in 33 of 43 participants (median +0.346, 95% interval +0.154 to +1.108), stable across FPKM and CPM (Spearman 0.996).
Adding the change to baseline expression raised held-out response AUC from 0.599 to 0.673, but the interval (−0.084 to +0.269) included no improvement, with only nine responders.

An observed on-treatment change is pharmacodynamic evidence, not a qualified predictive biomarker. Biopsy timing and selection into a second biopsy limit its interpretation at a fixed information time.
en.seo_title: What changes in tumor immune expression during nivolumab?
en.seo_description: Public GEO series GSE91061: 43 paired pre- and on-nivolumab tumor RNA samples, fixed immune scores, paired change and response-association diagnostics.
